submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 with a 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency (91.534%) while meeting all constraints. This represents a significant improvement over the other candidates: 6.3 percentage points better than Algorithm-L2 (85.189%) and 17.3 percentage points better than Algorithm-L1 (74.056%) at the same threshold. The 40 GeV threshold was identified as optimal through systematic evaluation across the allowed 20-60 GeV range, where efficiency peaked at this value. All algorithms were confirmed to be hardware deployable at the Level-1 trigger, and the 40 GeV threshold falls well within the specified constraints. This configuration provides the best performance for the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.
